Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 25, "heading": "CHAPTER XXIII", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u025-r0094", "target": "— Брак или не брак, — ответила она, — вы должны уехать — сегодня ночью — оба. Иначе я сойду с ума. Предупреждаю вас: я не смогу выносить ваше присутствие. Я не могу, я знаю, что не смогу видеть вас, пока меня будут выдавать замуж за Генри и после того, как я выйду за Генри. — О, прошу вас, прошу, поймите меня правильно. Я действительно люблю Генри, но не так… не в том смысле… не так, как люблю вас. Я — и мне не стыдно той смелости, с которой я это говорю, — люблю Генри примерно так же, как вы любите Королеву; но вас я люблю так, как должна была бы любить Генри, как вы должны были бы любить Королеву, как, я знаю, вы любите меня.", "source_sha256": "72cdb33da9381c17e81a705cf82f4cae757e8a78a0a9f1101bd035a0da15f5d3", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u025-r0094", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a1223cd40f459b71c0ce586de69c51d33a8ce2d2de7c8b0f66416573c650c332"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u025-r0095", "target": "Она схватила его руку и прижала к своему сердцу.", "source_sha256": "254e7694c689ced5abe21274a1dfa9786a79588699c2fd8fc4fbf0534b05f3f1", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u025-r0095", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "f10a974307ae88822b2a7190bf718a5b2b1a5e167576945fc3de4b3b552e184b"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u025-r0096", "tag": "p", "text": "“There! ", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u025-r0098", "tag": "p", "text": "“I shall keep this,” he announced.", "sha256": "e2e38fc63ee71e82c708e3e3da6e5d51a63b6866959fa21a7f8e748f3e285387", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2195]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u025-r0099", "tag": "p", "text": "“You oughtn’t to,” she flashed a last fond smile at him. “You may,” she added, as she turned and was gone.", "sha256": "27b045a2539442b5387d19db8d87cdc41e138f74204fd12c67d814fe8ee5df4a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2196]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u025-r0100", "tag": "p", "text": "Yet Yi Poon had a commission to execute, for which Torres had paid him one hundred gold in advance. Next morning, with Francis and the Queen hours departed on their way to Colon, Yi Poon arrived at the Solano hacienda. Enrico, smoking a cigar on the veranda and very much pleased with himself and all the world and the way the world was going, recognized and welcomed Yi Poon as his visitor of the day before. Even ere they talked, Leoncia’s father had dispatched Alesandro for the five hundred pesos agreed upon. And Yi Poon, whose profession was trafficking in secrets, was not averse to selling his secret the second time. Yet was he true to his salt, in so far as he obeyed Torres’ instructions in refusing to tell the secret save in the presence of Leoncia and Henry.", "sha256": "a848f02285395ce1f5b3ffae4c9876d835d101ac3479cebf0c0f73d4626e55e6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2197]", "source_html": "

He tried to appear uninterested, but his side-glances missed nothing of what they did. Next, Enrico saw Henry step back and exclaim in a dazed, heart-broken way:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u025-r0104", "tag": "p", "text": "“But, my God, Leoncia! This is the end of everything. Never can we be husband and wife!”", "sha256": "fef04adf0e1163f2c42e2213d6e42d0a597d3a51a742c42aaa16c7f7680687cb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2201]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u025-r0106", "tag": "p", "text": "Henry, almost in stupefaction, looked to Leoncia to speak for him.", "sha256": "3cd0ed558dfcb3e6924ac4fa0a117d5aacba57df31fe5686e12f9929dd52f307", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2203]", "source_html": "
